name: search_strings
description: Search every provider-reported string object or candidate using literal matching by default or regex when requested. Results are deterministic and complete over that provider inventory, not every text sequence in artifact bytes. Kuna scans mapped sequences of at least five characters, including unterminated fragments, without computing references. Ghidra reports each defined string's encoding, byte length and termination; it may omit packed or undefined literals, including Rust strings; an empty result does not prove text is absent. For known encoded bytes, Ghidra search_bytes can find byte matches; a hit does not establish a string or use. If an address is known, xrefs can look for references; read_bytes can inspect bytes where supported (not available with Kuna). Hopper retains typed byte decoding, native display, and explicit decoding unknowns. Adjacent long-literal fragments match independently. For Ghidra case-insensitive literal searches, raw_result contains unfiltered candidates; normalized_result contains matches. Regex dialect depends on the provider: Ghidra uses Java Pattern; Kuna, IDA and Hopper use ECMAScript Unicode. See binary_session for selected-provider limits. Hopper regex mode uses a cancellable worker. The matching deadline is REA_REGEX_MATCHING_DEADLINE_MS (a positive decimal integer of milliseconds from 1 to 2147483647, default 5000). Unset keeps the default. A deadline failure names the effective milliseconds, source (default or setting), the default, and the maximum, and leaves the API usable. The worker old-generation request is REA_REGEX_WORKER_HEAP_REQUEST_MIB (a decimal integer of mebibytes from 7 to 16384, default 128). Unset keeps the default. A positive Node --max-old-space-size, including NODE_OPTIONS, overrides that request and is not limited by the setting's floor or maximum. A heap failure names the effective request, its source (default or setting), the default, the floor, and the maximum. Select detail summary for counts and retained native-inventory pages; complete remains the default.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.
